title: Visible Human Female — full skeletal mesh reference

source.datasetCitation: Alavi, S. H., & Asseln, M. (2026). Visible-Human-3d-Models. https://doi.org/10.57967/hf/10464
source.originalCitation: Andreassen, T. E., Hume, D. R., Hamilton, L. D., Walker, K. E., Higinbotham, S. E., & Shelburne, K. B. (2023). Three Dimensional Lower Extremity Musculoskeletal Geometry of the Visible Human Female and Male. Scientific Data, 10, 34. https://doi.org/10.1038/s41597-022-01905-2

anatomy.unit: STL mesh coordinates are patient-space coordinates; transform and scale must be validated against the atlas before display.
knownLimitations: Elbow region is incomplete; distal humerus and proximal radius/ulna are truncated.
Finger and toe phalanges are grouped by digit rather than segmented individually.
Cranium and maxilla are one mesh; mandible is separate.
Manubrium, sternal body and xiphoid process are combined.
Hyoid and most sesamoid bones are not included.
Costal cartilages are not included; rib meshes do not connect geometrically to the sternum.
